basis: source_observation_protocol_v1 and two inherited inventories; no current observation values

rules: Repository-relative public path only; original values preserved.
Anonymous private-file alias may describe source identity but is never an image URL.

top_level.schema: source_geometry_viewer_v1 (future; current skeleton accepts preview_v1 only)

snapshot.release_state: explicit frozen state, never inferred from file existence

top_level.inherited_payloads: Exact copied inherited_sources and operational_scope_inventory with SHA, old/current split unchanged
top_level.current_source_qualification: null until frozen; then three rows F03/F04/F06 with actual request ledger and source refs
top_level.current_observation_records: null until frozen; then two named record packages, each actual record_kind=image_observation or text_review and actual scope
top_level.current_comparison: null until frozen; comparison rows keyed by full entry_id+original_record_id+phenomenon, including absent/unreviewed status
top_level.common_g_mapping: null until frozen; scoped conditional map and unresolved rule/ledger gaps; never one choice per cap/entry

source_qualification_row.prior_attempt_refs: all relevant old failure/placeholder references; no silent deletion

requests.access_outcome: actual frozen vocabulary; HTTP200 not synonymous with image

source_qualification_row.retained_source_ids: preserve original plus separately identified candidate files
source_qualification_row.availability_conclusion: bounded factual scope; not globally nonexistent if not obtained

observation_package.observer: actual agent identity; same AI/exposed disclosure

view_receipts.xywh: original coordinate system or null if no view
view_receipts.reviewed_scope: scope actually read; generated crop alone is not viewed

rows.original_record_id: preserve U/J/B/CAND/R/A/C/Z/T identity, not fabricated units
rows.view_refs: [] for text-only review; cannot fabricate view receipts
rows.local_exclusion: scope/evidence/limitations or null; absence of certified T does not prove no route
rows.aliases_and_dependencies: all shared paths, children, mutually exclusive cases, optional brown affiliation

comparison_row.record_a_refs: source_ref[] or null (not connected/no matching record distinctly labeled)
comparison_row.agreement_or_difference: original conclusions preserved, not majority vote
comparison_row.root_synthesis: separate frozen synthesis source_ref, if supplied
comparison_row.limitations: no whole-signature inference from a local agreement

g_mapping_row.shared_variable: g_terminal_boundary; same g for applicable six-entry scope
g_mapping_row.inherited_map_refs: old case-retention origins are not observed per-unit mapping
g_mapping_row.conditional_rows: each g, retained original case/role and premises; all scopes retained
g_mapping_row.observational_basis_refs: local factual evidence/exclusion, separate from g premise
g_mapping_row.definition_change: new version/diff if needed; never silently update W6 model

display_rules: No private pixels, img, canvas, SVG manuscript redraw or network image fetch; official links only.
Null means no connected frozen value; not zero, false, unviewed or failure.
All six entries and complete inherited records remain reachable; all three source qualifications retain failures and unknowns.
Two actual observation packages cannot be labeled image observations if one is text review.
Old views/timestamps never counted as new observations.
Source-native navigation boxes not segmentation or calibrated boundaries.
No H/H4 calculations, conditioned scores or success percentages.
Actual frozen status is attached explicitly; skeleton does not poll workflow or guess background state.
